explanation: OEIS A363347 (denominator of 1/(2 − 3/(3 − 4/(… (n−1) − n/(−4))))), Conjecture 2: 'The sequence contains all prime numbers which end with a 1 or 9.' The formal continuedFractionDenominator evaluates R_k = k − (k+1)/R_{k+1} with R_{n−1} = (n−1) + n/4, and a(n) = |numerator of R_2| is the denominator of 1/R_2. This matches the DATA (checked n < 20: 11, 5, 31, 11, 59, …). The statement 'every prime ≡ 1, 9 (mod 10) equals some a(n)' matches. Faithful.
